segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I had us down to talk through the 38-seat expansion and the May 15 go-live for the support team.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We have 27 users today, adding 11 more. The main thing is keeping the invoice clean because finance wants one line item for the subscription and one for onboarding.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that works. The quote I sent this morning shows $42,180 annual subscription for 38 seats, plus $3,200 for onboarding. Net 30, same master terms you signed last year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the added seats start billing June 1, not immediately, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, June 1 start for billing. We can still open the seats on May 15 for configuration and training, no extra charge for that setup window.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Training-wise, we need two admin sessions and one end-user session. Can those happen the week of May 6?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so implementation has May 7 at 1 p.m. Eastern and May 9 at 11 a.m. Eastern held for admins, and May 13 at 2 p.m. for the end users. Those are included in the onboarding line.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Legal asked one question: the renewal date stays February 28, 2026, even with this add-on?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Exactly. The add-on co-terms to February 28, 2026. The order form lists the prorated period from June 1 through February 28, then it rolls into the regular renewal.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Send me the final order form and I'll route it today. If it's under $50,000, our controller can sign without a second review.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Already attached to the email I just sent, order form OF-1846. Total due this term is $34,835 because of the proration, plus the $3,200 onboarding. Let me know if the invoice needs a PO number.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Use PO-7714. If you can put that on the first invoice, we're good.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. Once it's signed, you'll get the kickoff invite with the same May dates and the admin checklist. Nothing else needed from your side today.
